content.short: Stablecoin off-ramp for Asia that lets you pay at any QR code and have merchants get local money.
content.description: Ripe connects stablecoins to everyday payments in Asia. Users scan a local QR code and pay from wallets like Phantom, Backpack, OKX, Trust or MetaMask, and the merchant receives fiat instantly. Ripe can also convert stablecoins straight into local e-wallets, turn incoming crypto into fiat automatically, and pay global teams in local currency. Wallets and exchanges can embed it directly.
content.meta: Pay any QR code in Asia with stablecoins from your own wallet using Ripe, while merchants receive local currency.
